# chartToSvg

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders the chart to an SVG string. Note: Chart SVG export uses standard font fallback rendering without per-glyph kerning. For accurate kerning with embedded fonts, render the chart via a Page using toSvg(Page) instead.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
chartToSvg(chart: ChartBase, data?: ChartData): string
```
